title: Standing Calf Raise
summary: A calf raise with straight knees, for the gastrocnemius.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: commercial gym machine (this exercise's own machine).

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for calves (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly calves total.

setup.text: Stand on a step or calf machine with the balls of your feet on the edge.
Let your heels drop for a deep stretch and pause there.
Rise up as high as you can.
Lower slowly back to the stretch.

form_cues.cue: Lower to a deep heel stretch
Rise as high as you can
Pause in the bottom stretch for a second. Bouncing skips most of the benefit.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.
